title: HRSA HPSA operational fields are unevenly populated across designation categories
source_unit: Current designated primary-care HRSA HPSA row; operational fields grouped by overlapping designation/type/population categories
geography: United States 50 states and DC; territories and Palau excluded; 20,905 rows and 2,888 counties

observations.period: Current HRSA file; all designated primary-care rows
observations.method: Current HRSA CSV parsed at row level; medians and availability counts; overlapping rows not summed.
observations.uncertainty: Fields are designation metadata, not active appointments, provider hours, travel, quality, price, or household outcomes; missing fields are not zero.
observations.subgroup: All designated primary-care rows across designation objects.
observations.counterinterpretation: Row-level values cannot be multiplied into national staffing or population totals because components overlap.

observations.period: Current HRSA file; geographic HPSA type
observations.method: Rows with Hpsa Geo or Hpsa Geo HN type; overlapping categories.
observations.uncertainty: Geographic designation is not resident reach or provider adequacy.
observations.counterinterpretation: Geography, selection, and component boundaries may drive values.

observations.period: Current HRSA file; population HPSA type
observations.method: Rows with Hpsa Pop type; overlapping categories.
observations.uncertainty: The designated population is not the PLACES county adult denominator and is not a patient-use measure.
observations.counterinterpretation: Higher row medians may reflect designation targeting rather than a causal shortage effect.

observations.period: Current HRSA file; facility/site HPSA type

fte_median.unit: FTE among only 543 rows with FTE

observations.method: Rows with RHC, FQHC, FQHC LAL, ITU, PRSN, or OFAC types; overlapping categories.
observations.uncertainty: The sparse FTE subset cannot represent all facility/site rows; missing is not zero and no active hours or patient capacity are observed.
observations.counterinterpretation: The low available-row FTE median should not be interpreted as low facility capacity for the full category.

observations.period: Current HRSA file; migrant/seasonal population code

denominator.unit: rows with M, MFW, LI-MFW, or LI-H-MFW code across 124 counties

observations.method: Rows with migrant/seasonal-related population code; overlapping categories.
observations.uncertainty: This selected group does not map to county-wide service use or resident outcomes and may require seasonal timing interpretation.
observations.counterinterpretation: Higher designated population and shortage fields do not establish more or less usable care.

related_sources.claim: Reproduction output for row-level HRSA operational-field availability and category medians.
HRSA shortage-area download and definitions context.

boundary: This record audits current HRSA designation fields. It does not establish active provider capacity, patient access, quality, price, travel, household outcomes, trust, or political response; overlapping component rows must not be summed into national totals.
